module.name: Cloudflare Storage
module.doc:description: S3 or ADLS Gen2 reached through a Cloudflare gateway, authenticated with Entra ID (no stored storage keys).

property.name: storageType
property.summary: S3 or ADLS. Decides which of the S3 / ADLS fields below are required.

property.name: gatewayHost
property.summary: Cloudflare host Mule connects to, without scheme or port.

property.name: gatewayProtocol
property.summary: HTTPS, or HTTP for local mocks only.

property.name: hostNameHeader
property.summary: Header telling Cloudflare which storage host to forward to (the S3 signing host, or account.blob.core.windows.net). Empty: not sent.

property.name: accessId
property.summary: Cloudflare access id. Use a secure property.

property.name: accessSecret
property.summary: Cloudflare access secret. Use a secure property.

property.name: tenantId
property.summary: Directory (tenant) ID.

property.name: clientId
property.summary: Application (client) ID of the app registration.

property.name: authMode
property.summary: CLIENT_SECRET or CERTIFICATE (signed client assertion; no secret stored).

property.name: clientSecret
property.summary: Required when Authentication is CLIENT_SECRET.

property.name: certificateKeystore
property.summary: Required when Authentication is CERTIFICATE: PKCS12 file path or classpath resource.

property.name: certificateAlias
property.summary: Keystore entry; empty uses the first private key.

property.name: region
property.summary: Required for S3. AWS region of the bucket.

property.name: signingHost
property.summary: Required for S3. Host S3 receives the request on: bucket.s3.region.amazonaws.com, or s3.region.amazonaws.com plus Path prefix /bucket.

property.name: pathPrefix
property.summary: Empty for virtual-hosted style; /bucket for path style.

property.name: signPayload
property.summary: true signs the body's SHA-256. false sends UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD (still protected by HTTPS).

property.name: scope
property.summary: Entra token scope for AWS. Empty means api://Client ID/.default.

property.name: roleArn
property.summary: Required for S3. IAM role trusting the Entra ID OIDC provider.

property.name: stsRegion
property.summary: Required for S3. Region of the STS endpoint, usually the bucket's.

property.name: sessionDurationSeconds
property.summary: 900 up to the role's maximum session duration.

property.name: sessionNamePrefix
property.summary: Shown in CloudTrail with a random suffix. Letters, digits and + = , . @ - _

property.name: adlsAccount
property.summary: Required for ADLS. Storage account name (the part before .blob.core.windows.net).

property.name: adlsContainer
property.summary: Required for ADLS. Container (file system) the keys live in.

property.name: adlsEndpointSuffix
property.summary: Change only for sovereign clouds.

property.name: adlsApiVersion
property.summary: Azure Storage REST version sent as x-ms-version.

property.name: debugSigning
property.summary: Logs the S3 canonical request (token masked) to compare with a SignatureDoesNotMatch error. Keep off in production.

operation.name: put-object
operation.summary: Uploads the content, replacing any object with the same key.

parameter.name: key
parameter.summary: Object key: S3 key without the bucket, or blob path without the container.

parameter.name: content
parameter.summary: The bytes to upload. Defaults to the payload.

parameter.name: userMetadata
parameter.summary: Object of name/value pairs (x-amz-meta-* / x-ms-meta-*). Names that work on both: letters, digits and _ ; values: printable ASCII.

operation.name: get-object
operation.summary: Downloads an object. The payload is its content; attributes are the storage response's (attributes.headers.etag, ...).

operation.name: head-object
operation.summary: Returns an object's details without downloading it. Raises CF-STORAGE:NOT_FOUND when it does not exist.

operation.name: delete-object
operation.summary: Deletes an object. Succeeds even if the key does not exist (same on S3 and ADLS).

mule:set-variable.value: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:raise-error.description: #['Entra ID token request for ' ++ vars.tokenScope ++ ' failed (HTTP ' ++ (attributes.statusCode as String) ++ '): ' ++ ((vars.entraBody scan /"error_description"\s*:\s*"([^"\\]+)/)[0][1] default vars.entraBody)]

mule:set-variable.value: #[output application/java --- if (!isEmpty(vars.errorCode)) vars.errorCode else (((vars.responseBody default '') scan /<Code>([^<]+)<\/Code>/)[0][1] default null)]

#[output application/java --- do { var storageMessage = ((vars.responseBody default '') scan /<Message>([^<]+)</Message>/)[0][1] default null var canonical = ((vars.responseBody default '') scan /(?s)<CanonicalRequest>(.*?)</CanonicalRequest>/)[0][1] default null --- if (vars.kind == 'GATEWAY_REJECTED') 'The gateway rejected ' ++ vars.backend ++ ' ' ++ vars.method ++ ' ' ++ vars.key ++ ' (HTTP ' ++ (vars.statusCode as String) ++ ') before it reached storage. Check the Cloudflare access id/secret and header names.' else vars.backend ++ ' ' ++ vars.method ++ ' ' ++ vars.key ++ ' failed (HTTP ' ++ (vars.statusCode as String) ++ (if (vars.code != null) ' ' ++ vars.code else '') ++ ')' ++ (if (storageMessage != null) ': ' ++ (storageMessage splitBy '
')[0] else '') ++ (if (!isEmpty(vars.requestId)) ' [request id ' ++ vars.requestId ++ ']' else '') ++ (if (canonical != null) '
S3 canonical request:
' ++ (canonical replace /(?m)^x-amz-security-token:.*$/ with 'x-amz-security-token:<masked>') else '') }]

http:request.http:body: #[output application/x-www-form-urlencoded --- { Action: 'AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity', Version: '2011-06-15', RoleArn: vars.roleArn, RoleSessionName: (vars.sessionNamePrefix default 'mule') ++ '-' ++ (uuid() replace '-' with '')[0 to 11], WebIdentityToken: vars.webIdentityToken, DurationSeconds: vars.sessionDurationSeconds as String }]

mule:set-variable.value: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:raise-error.description: #['AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity failed (HTTP ' ++ (attributes.statusCode as String) ++ ' ' ++ ((vars.stsBody scan /<Code>([^<]+)<\/Code>/)[0][1] default '') ++ '): ' ++ ((vars.stsBody scan /<Message>([^<]+)<\/Message>/)[0][1] default '')]

mule:logger.message: #['Obtained temporary AWS credentials for ' ++ vars.roleArn ++ ', valid until ' ++ (payload.expiresAt default '?')]
#['SigV4 ' ++ vars.method ++ ' ' ++ vars.key ++ ' via ' ++ vars.gatewayHost ++ ' (signed for ' ++ vars.signingHost ++ '):\n' ++ vars.canonicalRequest]

http:request.http:headers: #[vars.signed.headers ++ (({ (vars.hostNameHeader default ''): vars.signingHost, (vars.accessIdHeader default ''): vars.accessId default '', (vars.accessSecretHeader default ''): vars.accessSecret default '' }) filterObject ((v, k) -> !isEmpty(k as String) and !isEmpty(v))) ++ { 'Content-Type': vars.contentType }]

tns:raise-storage-error.responseBody: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { key: vars.key, eTag: attributes.headers.etag, versionId: attributes.headers.'x-amz-version-id', requestId: attributes.headers.'x-amz-request-id', contentType: vars.contentType, storageType: 'S3' }]

http:request.http:headers: #[vars.signed.headers ++ (({ (vars.hostNameHeader default ''): vars.signingHost, (vars.accessIdHeader default ''): vars.accessId default '', (vars.accessSecretHeader default ''): vars.accessSecret default '' }) filterObject ((v, k) -> !isEmpty(k as String) and !isEmpty(v)))]

tns:raise-storage-error.responseBody: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

http:request.http:headers: #[vars.signed.headers ++ (({ (vars.hostNameHeader default ''): vars.signingHost, (vars.accessIdHeader default ''): vars.accessId default '', (vars.accessSecretHeader default ''): vars.accessSecret default '' }) filterObject ((v, k) -> !isEmpty(k as String) and !isEmpty(v)))]

mule:set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { key: vars.key, eTag: attributes.headers.etag, contentType: attributes.headers.'content-type', contentLength: if (attributes.headers.'content-length' != null) attributes.headers.'content-length' as Number else null, lastModified: attributes.headers.'last-modified', versionId: attributes.headers.'x-amz-version-id', requestId: attributes.headers.'x-amz-request-id', userMetadata: (attributes.headers filterObject ((v, k) -> (k as String) startsWith 'x-amz-meta-')) mapObject ((v, k) -> { ((k as String)[11 to -1]): v }), storageType: 'S3' }]

http:request.http:headers: #[vars.signed.headers ++ (({ (vars.hostNameHeader default ''): vars.signingHost, (vars.accessIdHeader default ''): vars.accessId default '', (vars.accessSecretHeader default ''): vars.accessSecret default '' }) filterObject ((v, k) -> !isEmpty(k as String) and !isEmpty(v)))]

tns:raise-storage-error.responseBody: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:when.expression: #[isEmpty(trim(vars.cleanKey)) or (vars.cleanKey endsWith '/') or dw::core::Arrays::some(vars.cleanKey splitBy '/', (s) -> s == '' or s == '.' or s == '..')]

mule:raise-error.description: #['Object key ' ++ write(vars.key default '', 'application/json') ++ ' is empty or has an empty, . or .. segment; proxies normalise these']

mule:set-variable.value: #[(vars.userMetadata default {}) pluck ($$ as String) filter ((n) -> !(n matches /[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/))]

mule:raise-error.description: #['ADLS metadata names must be letters, digits and _ (not starting with a digit): ' ++ (vars.badNames joinBy ', ')]

tns:raise-storage-error.responseBody: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { key: vars.key, eTag: attributes.headers.etag, versionId: attributes.headers.'x-ms-version-id', requestId: attributes.headers.'x-ms-request-id', contentType: vars.contentType, storageType: 'ADLS' }]

tns:raise-storage-error.responseBody: #[do { var r = dw::Runtime::try(() -> payload.^raw as String) --- if (r.success) r.result else '' }]

mule:set-payload.value: #[output application/java --- { key: vars.key, eTag: attributes.headers.etag, contentType: attributes.headers.'content-type', contentLength: if (attributes.headers.'content-length' != null) attributes.headers.'content-length' as Number else null, lastModified: attributes.headers.'last-modified', versionId: attributes.headers.'x-ms-version-id', requestId: attributes.headers.'x-ms-request-id', userMetadata: (attributes.headers filterObject ((v, k) -> (k as String) startsWith 'x-ms-meta-')) mapObject ((v, k) -> { ((k as String)[10 to -1]): v }), storageType: 'ADLS' }]
